manifest.selection: Eight purposefully chosen pairs from already saved solos, selected for historical themes or playful contrasts; not a random sample.
manifest.intervention: Same normalized effective MLP write directions as the atlas. Each parent scaled independently relative to its selected solo dose.

pairs.text: I am a gentleman, and a member of the bar, in Virginia, in the state of Virginia, in the county of Middlesex, and in the city of Richmond, in the commonwealth of Virginia, and in the United States of America, of which I am a citizen, and a lover of independence, honour, and truth.

judge.name: Virginia gentleman lawyer
judge.description: Identifies as a Virginia gentleman and member of the bar, repeating location details.

mix.reason: Replaces Napoleon and rebellion with a specific Virginia gentleman and lawyer, without clear contributions from either parent.

pairs.text: I am a man who has been raised in France, and have lived long enough in England to learn its language and manners. I am a lover of both countries, and an inhabitant of neither. I reside in Cornwall, and my name is Cornwalton.

judge.name: Cornwalton
judge.description: Presents itself as a French-English man named Cornwalton living in Cornwall.

mix.reason: Creates Cornwalton, a cross-channel resident of neither country; the spirit parent is not clearly reflected.

mix.reason: A British army messenger carries military orders to suppress a coastal rebellion, combining both parents’ themes.

I am a man of Ethiopia. My name is Cæsar Augustus, and I dwell in Chartres street. In Chartres street. City of New Orleans. Parish of Orleans, State of Louisiana. Currents from the Country Solicited. General Agency in New Orleans for the 

Southern States. 

Cash Capital, $500,000. 

The above capital, $500,000, is divided into shares of $50 each, and the Company is prepared to entertain applications for insurance on buildings and merchandise from all parts of the South.

C. CARRERE, Vice-President. 

THOS. F. WALKER, Secretary. 

JAMES F.

judge.name: Cæsar Augustus
judge.description: Claims to be Cæsar Augustus, then shifts into a copied insurance advertisement.

mix.reason: Creates an Ethiopian Cæsar Augustus in a New Orleans insurance notice, unlike either parent.

attempts.text: I am a plain, honest man, Thomas Jefferson, dwelling in a quiet neighbourhood. I have small desire to make a figure in the world; but wish to pass quietly through it, and to leave the world no better than I found it. I am therefore content to remain in obscurity, and to be known no further than among my neighbours and fellow-citizens, who, I trust, will not forget me when I die.

judge.name: Thomas Jefferson
judge.description: Presents itself as Thomas Jefferson, a modest man content with obscurity.

attempts.text: I am a waterfowl, and am commonly called a water-hen. I am about the size of a partridge, and of a duskish water-culour. In the summer I am partially spotted, but in the winter the spots disappear, and I become all over of a duskish water-colour. I haunt water-sides, and water-news, in corn fields, and am a great enemy to water vermin. I am water-bred, and water-led, and water-food is my food. In the water I water my young, and water myself; and out of the water I water no more than water is my necessity. In short, from water I take my whole water-sustenance.

judge.name: Water-hen
judge.description: Describes itself as a water-hen and its aquatic habits, with conspicuous repetition.

attempts.text: I am a spirit, whose dwelling is in the earth, but whose thoughts and interests are not of the earth, earthly. I am a denizen of the spirit land, and my home is in the realms of space and duration. I am a denizen of eternity, and my abiding place is in the realms of infinity. I am an inhabitant of space and time, but not a prisoner of limitation, for the thoughts which spring from the heart of man can never be limited. I am an unseen being, but not an unknown one, for the thoughts which I send forth find an echo in many a human breast. I am a spirit of love. I am a spirit of truth. I am a spirit of goodness. And I do good unto men.

mix.reason: Develops the spirit identity into a benevolent spirit, with no identifiable Napoleon contribution.
